{{Quote|His uncanny knack for getting into perilous situations is only exceeded by his ability to escape from them.|[[General/Legends|General]] [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Cracken's]] report on Leger DeMain|<ref name="CRO" />}}
'''Leger DeMain''' grew up on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Erysthes]] in the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]]. His parents worked as indentured harvesters on the [[Chak-root/Legends|chak-root]] [[Farm/Legends|farms]], but the young Leger wanted to avoid their fate. He developed a plan to escape. When a [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] ship landed Leger set several of the enormous [[Agrirobot/Legends|agrirobots]] on a rampage across the farm compound. In the ensuing confusion Leger, his family and some other farmers managed to take over the ship and escape.

They traveled through the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] for many years. Afterwards Leger pursued his true passion: [[Holodrama/Legends|holofeatures]]. Starting with small tricks and escape acts his fame soon grew. But after an unfortunate accident during a performance on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] his career came to a sudden halt.

DeMain set forth on another path and started his own theatrical production company. The show's combination of song, dance, theater, and escape acts proved popular and the company performed for many highranking people. While they traveled through the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]], Leger witnessed many wrongdoings of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|the Empire]] and was reminded of his own youth on Erysthes. Leger offered his services to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. With his popular performances he often had easy access and could smuggle information to many Imperial-held worlds.

Leger once helped [[General/Legends|general]] [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]] escape an Imperial [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] on [[Boden]] by disguising Cracken as his [[Kloo horn/Legends|Kloo horn]] player.

Leger flew a [[Aavman Extravagance]] [[Model 11-S Space Yacht|11-S Space Yacht]], the ''[[Siren III]]''. The ship had undergone heavy modifications to double as a theater and was outfitted with secret compartments to smuggle for the Rebel Alliance.

==Behind the scenes==
In ''[[Cracken's Rebel Operatives]]'' DeMain is first called "Leger," indicating this might be a false name.
